title: 1. FC Union Berlin - Wikipedia
content: V.**, commonly known as **Union Berlin** (pronounced  ⓘ), is a professional German football club based in Berlin. During the Cold War, Union was based in East Berlin, joining the German league structure upon the reunification of the country in 1990. In 2019, Union won promotion to the Bundesliga for the first time in the club's history. The following season, the club qualified for the Champions League for the first time in their history, by finishing fourth in the Bundesliga. It is the second-largest in the German capital and has been home to Union Berlin and its forerunners since it opened in 1920. FC Union Berlin was used by two football clubs that shared a common origin as *FC Olympia Oberschöneweide*, founded in 1906 in Oberschöneweide, which at that time was a suburb of Berlin. 1. FC Union Berlin was founded during the reorganization of East German football in December 1965 and January 1966, when ten dedicated football clubs "Football club (East Germany)") were created.
